caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on the page, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on a beige background. The teapot has a rounded body with a domed lid, topped by a small knob. The handle is large and curved, shaded dark, and is attached at the upper left. The spout is elongated, slender, and curves outward from the right side. A decorative horizontal band encircles the upper portion of the teapot just below the lid, featuring a geometric pattern. On the side of the teapot's body, there is a circular ornamental motif consisting of a monogram or interwoven letters encircled by a garland of leaves. The shadows and highlights suggest the teapot is made of a reflective material. The whole drawing is framed by a simple rectangular outline drawn with a thin line. The artist's signature is located in the bottom left corner outside the object.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
